analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, reflecting a 35% year-on-year growth, alongside EBITDA of ₹89 crore and PAT of ₹47 crore. Operational performance was supported by fertilizer production of 89,747 MT, with capacity utilization standing at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit. Management expects to achieve an additional 30%-35% turnover growth over last year and projects quarterly revenue to exceed ₹500 crore over the remaining quarters of FY27. To enhance stock liquidity, the company also completed a 5-for-1 stock split during the quarter. Krishana Phoschem Limited presented its Q1 FY27 financial results, reporting a 34.58% YoY increase in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly revenue of over ₹500 crore in the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: At peak utilization of its current asset base, Krishana Phoschem can generate total revenue of more than ₹3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: Based on the capacity and the pricing I have mentioned, the total revenue potential can be more than ₹3,000 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during FY27.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company expects top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: Management targets overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import around 150,000 metric tons of material generating approximately Rs. 1,000 crore of revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Material improvement in rainfall during early July triggered a rapid recovery in Kharif sowing progress and fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSPs, and government NBS support are expected to sustain fertilizer demand in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth driven by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government backing via the NBS framework are creating a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: P&K production reached 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak Rabi period.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects domestic fertilizer demand to remain stable supported by a normal monsoon forecast and adequate water levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem will source third-party green ammonia under an arrangement with the Government of India starting in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: See this capacity of green ammonia is of a third-party capacity and we will buy this green ammonia with an arrangement from the Government of India, Department of Fertilizer one thing. And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion proposals that are pending board approval.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem completed expansion taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity was enhanced to 99,000 MTPA to strengthen backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: • Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: No additional capex or expansion plans are currently planned beyond what has been implemented.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%–30% of raw material cost increases via higher subsidies and MRP adjustments.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs. This has been achieved through a combination of higher subsidy support and revisions in MRPs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins averaged 7%–8% for trading operations and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Production and sales of new NPK grades contributed to EBITDA margin expansion in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The production and sales of these new NPK products during the quarter contributed to the improvement in EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation increased to ₹13 crore and finance costs rose to ₹20 crore following the commissioning of new capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly PAT grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Overall EBITDA margin decreased from 13.54% to 12.34% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our overall EBITDA margin, which was 13.54% has come down to 12.34%.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA per ton was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects profitability margins to be under pressure in FY27.
margins_costs.quote: As mentioned earlier, margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in the trading business is around 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, capacity utilization reached 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The addition of 165,000 MT capacity increased total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 sales volumes reached 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP, 36,300 MT for SSP, and 21,000 MT for trading.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT during Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, manufacturing volumes were approximately 383,000 metric tons and trading volumes were around 93,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Rock phosphate beneficiation capacity stands at around 200,000 tons with utilization between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivables collection during Q1 FY27 was more than ₹700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars including disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansion was funded using a mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables stood at almost Rs. 400 crore and other receivables ranged between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Q1 FY27 faced global supply disruptions, elevated raw material costs, and geopolitical uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: A nearly 40% rainfall deficit by June-end caused national Kharif sowing to drop 22.7% year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues near the Strait of Hormuz increased freight costs, delayed vessels, and raised procurement expenses.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input prices rose from mid-February onwards due to supply constraints and higher logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch between slowing domestic demand in March and rising input costs led to cost pressures.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fertilizer industry relies on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, exposing cost structures to global price movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.
